Iris: Quick thread  Glimmer customer interview done. goal: short case blog, two approved quotes, and a 45s social clip. embargo target 2026-04-22. who owns transcript?
Sam: Audio uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/glimmer/raw/glimmer_interview_2026-03-24.wav. I can run transcription + diarization.
AudioOps: Transcription job started  ETA ~1h. will produce diarized .txt and .srt.
Iris: Need two pull quotes (one conservative) for legal signoff. Priya, can you extract candidates and email the customer?
Priya: Draft quotes:
- "Glimmer cut our per-request cost substantially within weeks."
- "Latency stabilized across regions after switching to Redwood."
Conservative fallback: "We observed notable cost reductions after migration." Sending to customer now with a signoff checkbox.
Jun (Legal): Heads up  avoid absolute percentages unless we have a KPI snapshot. if customer supplies metrics, we need explicit written approval. turnaround 48h.
PublishBot: Transcription complete  files uploaded to s3://redwood-marketing/glimmer/deliverables/ at 2026-03-24T12:11:05Z :white_check_mark:
Sam: Uploaded diarized transcript and generated srt. marked timestamps for 45s highlight (00:00:58-00:01:43).
Priya: Customer signed the conservative quote this morning. emailed copy to Jun for legal redline.
Jun (Legal): Minor punctuation edits only. legal cleared the conservative quote.
Iris: Great  locking embargo 2026-04-22. Sam please produce the 45s captioned clip and add assets to deliverables folder. Ill draft the launch brief and share in #marketing once assets are in. :tada:
